authority: Latest explicit user decisions; SCOPE_APPROVALS.csv; balanced reference policy. Historical paper requirements remain provenance, not permission for extra production.

requirements.requirement: Coverage and missingness of the selected SES definitions and actual analysis samples
requirements.evidence: Source/mapping coverage, weighted and unweighted valid samples, missing-year reasons; no substitution of SES constructs.

requirements.requirement: Population, response, exclusions, mode and national sample qualifications
requirements.evidence: Official cycle/country documentation joined to exact source and target population; keep quality qualifications visible.

requirements.requirement: Verify the chosen Cobreros four-wave SES implementation against its pinned author evidence
requirements.evidence: Pinned author code/parameters and numerical parity for the used implementation. Historical 34-system replication is not dashboard membership.

requirements.requirement: Document applicability of the historical two-wave Cobreros validation to the chosen method
requirements.evidence: Method dependency audit. If the two-wave variant is unused, demonstrate exclusion; do not add it or force 36 countries to satisfy an old slide.

requirements.requirement: Verify fixed-parameter harmonization and source mappings used beyond the author calibration sample
requirements.evidence: Parameter/calibration fingerprints, source-field overlap, missingness and comparability for actual project years/countries.

requirements.requirement: Exact balanced references, country uncertainty and rank dependencies
requirements.evidence: Admission per country/age/domain with at least three comparable waves. Full selected-combination focus years and all jointly shown groups and class/school composition; fixed membership within a figure, allowed to differ between figures. Domain-independent composition retains its own study/population and complete figure years/groups. Equal-country mean, focus excluded, same rank basis, no group rank line.

requirements.requirement: Check SES scope discipline and approved Home-SES appendix comparability
requirements.evidence: PISA uses the chosen Innovamat/Cobreros method; do not add official wave-specific ESCS analyses from the old scientific deck. A04 permits official IEA Home SES in appendix only, with harmonized definitions and explicit unavailable years.

requirements.requirement: Correct uncertainty for necessary, registered paper claims
requirements.evidence: Claim IDs, exact parent cells, joint covariance and linking uncertainty where applicable. No automatic systematic trend-test suite or inferred cohort effects.
